quests.instruction: What item do we wear that needs no belt, since the straps hold it up, and also with a front panel and straps that go over our shoulders?
quests.question: Overalls
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They have straps that go over your shoulders!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Overalls have shoulder straps and a front panel, so they never need a belt!
quests.funFact: Overalls are pants that have a bib and straps over the shoulders.

quests.instruction: What do we call the edge that pops up or lies flat around the neck of a shirt?
quests.question: Collar
quests.hint: It circles around your neck.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Collar is the folded edge of a shirt that circles your neck!
quests.funFact: The collar is the part of a shirt that wraps around the neck.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that stretches a little as we bend, run, or sit down?
quests.question: Suspenders
quests.hint: Hint: They do the same job as a belt, but differently.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Suspenders clip over your shoulders to hold your pants up without a belt!
quests.funFact: Suspenders are straps worn over the shoulders to hold up pants.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear instead of a regular sweater, when we want extra neck warmth?
quests.question: Turtleneck
quests.hint: It hugs your neck snugly, like a little tube.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Turtleneck has a tall collar that covers your neck for extra warmth!
quests.funFact: A turtleneck is a sweater with a high, tube-like collar.

quests.instruction: What do we call the part we pull up over our hair to keep the rain off our head?
quests.question: Hood
quests.hint: You pull it up over your hair.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Hood is the part that pulls up over your head to keep rain off!
quests.funFact: A hood is a head covering attached to a jacket or sweatshirt.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that swooshes dramatically every time we spin around?
quests.question: Cape
quests.hint: Hint: It has no sleeves and no arms at all.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Cape ties at your neck and flows behind you for a bold, heroic look!
quests.funFact: A cape is a sleeveless garment that hangs over the back and shoulders.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that is thick, puffy, and keeps every part of us warm at once?
quests.question: Snowsuit
quests.hint: Hint: You wear this to play in deep snow.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Snowsuit covers your whole body in one warm piece for playing in deep snow!
quests.funFact: A snowsuit is a heavily insulated outfit for playing in the snow.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear instead of a pullover sweater, so it is easy to take on and off?
quests.question: Cardigan
quests.hint: You can leave it open or button it up.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Cardigan opens down the front with buttons, making it easy to put on!
quests.funFact: A cardigan is a sweater that opens completely in the front.

quests.instruction: What do we wear before we skateboard, ski, or ride a scooter?
quests.question: Helmet
quests.hint: Hint: It buckles under your chin.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Helmet has a hard shell that protects your head during sports and biking!
quests.funFact: A helmet is a hard hat designed to protect your brain from injury.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that hangs down the front of a dress shirt?
quests.question: Tie
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear this for a fancy, formal event.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Tie is knotted at the collar to make an outfit look fancy and formal!
quests.funFact: A tie is a long piece of decorative cloth worn around the neck.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that buckles snugly around our chest for water safety?
quests.question: Life Jacket
quests.hint: Hint: You wear this to stay safe near deep water.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Life Jacket helps you float safely, worn for water safety near deep water!
quests.funFact: A life jacket is filled with special foam that floats on water.

quests.instruction: What do we wear after playing sports, to stay warm while we cool down?
quests.question: Sweatshirt
quests.hint: Hint: Athletes often wear these after a game to stay warm.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Sweatshirt is thick and warm like a hoodie, but has no hood at all!
quests.funFact: Sweatshirts are thick, long-sleeved shirts meant to keep you warm.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear to keep warm without wearing a heavy coat?
quests.question: Jacket
quests.hint: It has long sleeves and often a zipper.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: Many jackets have zippers so you can put them on quickly.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear under a dress or skirt for extra warmth?
quests.question: Leggings
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You can wear these under a skirt or dress.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Leggings are soft and stretchy, moving easily with your legs when you play!
quests.funFact: Leggings are skin-tight pants made of stretchy material.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear when we want to keep our head warm in winter?
quests.question: Hat
quests.hint: It covers your hair.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: A hard hat protects construction workers from falling objects.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of a shirt and skirt worn separately?
quests.question: Dress
quests.hint: It often twirls when you spin.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: A wedding dress is traditionally white in many Western cultures.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that gets wet and dries quickly after a swim?
quests.question: Swimsuit
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You change into this before jumping in a pool.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Swimsuit is made to get wet and dry quickly for swimming!
quests.funFact: A swimsuit is made of special fabric that dries very quickly.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear to keep our feet dry in wet, muddy weather?
quests.question: Boots
quests.hint: They are perfect for muddy puddles.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Hiking boots have deep treads to prevent slipping on mud and rocks.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that keeps every drop of rain off our clothes?
quests.question: Raincoat
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear this on drizzly, puddle-splashing days.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Raincoat keeps rain from soaking your clothes on a wet, drizzly day!
quests.funFact: Raincoats are made of waterproof materials like rubber or treated nylon.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that comes in two matching pairs, one for each foot?
quests.question: Shoes
quests.hint: You wear socks underneath these.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: Running shoes have thick, bouncy soles to absorb shock.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear through the little loops on the top of our pants?
quests.question: Belt
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It buckles at the front to stay snug.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Belt goes around your waist to keep your pants from slipping down!
quests.funFact: A belt is a strap worn around the waist to keep pants from falling down.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear to keep the strong sunlight from hurting our eyes?
quests.question: Sunglasses
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear these on a beach or on a bright day.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Sunglasses shade your eyes so bright sunlight does not hurt them!
quests.funFact: Sunglasses have tinted lenses to protect your eyes from bright light.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear to dress up as a superhero, animal, or fairy tale character?
quests.question: Costume
quests.hint: Think about this: You might wear one for a dress-up party or a play.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Costume lets you dress up and pretend to be someone or something fun!
quests.funFact: A costume is an outfit worn to look like someone or something else.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of our regular clothes once bedtime arrives?
quests.question: Pajamas
quests.hint: They are soft and loose, not tight.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Some people love wearing onesie pajamas that cover them from head to toe.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear for a very fancy party, tied just below our chin, and also instead of a long tie, for a fun, fancy look?
quests.question: Bow Tie
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is shaped like a little bow, not a long strip!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Bow Tie is tied into a small bow shape at the collar for a fancy look!
quests.funFact: A bow tie is a necktie tied in the shape of a bow.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear made from a sturdy blue fabric called denim?
quests.question: Jeans
quests.hint: Think about this: They are made from a tough fabric called denim.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Jeans are made from tough denim, strong enough for climbing and rough play!
quests.funFact: Jeans are tough pants made from a blue fabric called denim.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear that slips over our head with no sleeves or buttons?
quests.question: Poncho
quests.hint: Think about this: It has no sleeves and no buttons.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Poncho is a simple piece with a head-hole that drapes over your shoulders!
quests.funFact: A poncho is a single sheet of fabric with a hole in the middle for your head.

quests.instruction: Which word means the part we roll up when our arms get too warm?
quests.question: Sleeve
quests.hint: Hint: You roll this up when you feel too warm.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Sleeve is the tube-shaped part of a top that covers your arm!
quests.funFact: The sleeve is the part of a garment that completely covers the arm.

quests.instruction: What do we wear instead of separate pajama pieces, for cozy one-piece sleeping?
quests.question: Onesie
quests.hint: Hint: It sometimes looks like a cute animal.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Onesie is one snug piece of clothing worn all in a single go!
quests.funFact: A onesie is a piece of clothing that covers the entire body in one garment.

quests.instruction: What do we wear instead of a swimsuit, when the ocean water feels icy cold?
quests.question: Wetsuit
quests.hint: Hint: Surfers wear this in cold ocean water.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Wetsuit fits snugly over your whole body to keep you warm in cold water!
quests.funFact: A wetsuit is a thick rubber suit worn by surfers and scuba divers.
